promoted.description: Ids that went to `ready`, with their tasks already pickable.

failed.description: Empty when the whole batch passed.

reason.example: Story is not ready: missing dod, dor
reason.description: Readable reason. The story may have lost its readiness, or one of its modules may have dropped out of `module_map` between the proposal and the decision.

400.description: Invalid body. The `ValidationPipe` runs with `whitelist` and `forbidNonWhitelisted`, so an unknown field also fails.

401.description: No token, expired token, or invalid signature.

429.description: Rate limit per user or per IP.
